note: 宝石镶嵌(Gemstone)系统入口 NPC。

messages.context: 第一次互动,介绍宝石系统
messages.text: Gemstones have magical properties and can be applied to some special items.
messages.gloss: Gemstone 是专有玩法名词“宝石”。
messages.zh: 宝石拥有神奇的属性,可以镶嵌到一些特殊物品上。
messages.raw: §aGemstones§f have magical properties and can be applied to some special items.

segments.text: have magical properties and can be applied to some special items.
segments.zh: 拥有神奇的属性,可以镶嵌到一些特殊物品上。

messages.text: There are 12 different Gemstones, all of them having their own unique properties!
messages.zh: 一共有12种不同的宝石,每一种都有各自独特的属性!
messages.raw: §fThere are §a12§f different Gemstones, all of them having their own unique properties!

segments.text: different Gemstones, all of them having their own unique properties!
segments.zh: 种不同的宝石,每一种都有各自独特的属性!

messages.context: 举例说明不同宝石的效果
messages.text: For example, adding Ruby to armor will increase its ❤ Health, while Jasper increases ❁ Strength.
messages.gloss: Ruby / Jasper 是具体宝石种类名,按 GLOSSARY.md「XX Crystal」条目确立的原则保持英文不翻译(此前这里译成了“红宝石”“碧玉”,已订正);❤/❁ 是游戏内属性图标符号,原样保留。英文和汉字之间的空格由引擎在片段接缝处自动补,写死在 zh 里的要自己写上。
messages.zh: 举个例子,给盔甲镶上 Ruby 会提升它的 ❤ 生命值,而 Jasper 则会提升 ❁ 力量。
messages.raw: §fFor example, adding §cRuby§f to armor will increase its §c❤ Health§f, while §dJasper§f increases §c❁ Strength§f.

messages.context: 说明宝石纯度影响效果强度
messages.text: The more pure the Gemstone - the stronger the effect!
messages.zh: 宝石纯度越高,效果就越强!
messages.raw: §fThe more pure the Gemstone - the stronger the effect!

messages.context: 说明并非所有物品都能镶嵌宝石,且可随时取出
messages.text: Only some items can have Gemstones applied, and you can remove them any time.
messages.zh: 只有部分物品可以镶嵌宝石,而且你可以随时取出它们。
messages.raw: §fOnly some items can have Gemstones applied, and you can remove them any time.

messages.context: 引导使用旁边的宝石研磨机
messages.text: Use the Gemstone Grinder next to me to apply Gemstones to items!
messages.gloss: Gemstone Grinder 是专有设施名(宝石研磨机)。
messages.zh: 用我旁边的宝石研磨机把宝石镶到物品上吧!
messages.raw: §fUse the §dGemstone Grinder§f next to me to apply Gemstones to items!

segments.text: next to me to apply Gemstones to items!

messages.context: 后续互动台词,介绍宝石品质等级(粗糙/有瑕/精细)
messages.text: There are several qualities of Gemstone, including Rough, Flawed, and Fine.
messages.gloss: Rough/Flawed/Fine 是宝石品质等级专有词,后续还有 Perfect,建议统一收录到术语表。
messages.zh: 宝石有好几种品质,包括粗糙、有瑕和精细。
messages.raw: §fThere are several qualities of Gemstone, including Rough, §aFlawed§f, and §9Fine§f.

segments.text: There are several qualities of Gemstone, including Rough,
segments.zh: 宝石分好几种品质,包括粗糙、

messages.context: 介绍最高品质 Perfect 的效果
messages.text: The highest quality of Gemstone - Perfect - will increase your stats the most!
messages.zh: 宝石的最高品质——完美——能带来最大的属性加成!
messages.raw: §fThe highest quality of Gemstone - §6Perfect§f - will increase your stats the most!

segments.zh: 宝石品质里最高的一档——

segments.text: - will increase your stats the most!

messages.context: 重复说明并非所有物品都能镶嵌
messages.text: Not all items can have Gemstones applied to them.
messages.zh: 并不是所有物品都能镶嵌宝石。
messages.raw: §fNot all items can have Gemstones applied to them.

messages.context: 引导查看宝石研磨机菜单确认适配物品
messages.text: Check out the Gemstone Grinder menu to check which items work with it!
messages.zh: 去看看宝石研磨机的菜单,确认哪些物品可以使用它吧!
messages.raw: §fCheck out the §dGemstone Grinder§f menu to check which items work with it!

segments.text: menu to check which items work with it!
segments.zh: 的菜单,就能看到哪些物品可以镶嵌!

messages.text: ✆ Sure I can give you my contact, but first let's play a little game!

segments.text: Sure I can give you my contact, but first let's play a little game!
segments.zh: 联系方式当然可以给你,不过我们先玩个小游戏!
